description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class for the Opencart admin extension system. It includes methods for managing language extensions, such as listing available languages, installing, and uninstalling language extensions, and handling related actions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing extension languages in the OpenCart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling language extensions, and integrates with other system components to handle language data and permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that sets the output response to the list of languages via getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and builds a list of available language extensions by scanning the filesystem and extension registry, preparing data for display in the admin view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a language extension based on request parameters. Registers the extension, updates permissions, and prepares the system to include the new language.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a language extension, removing its settings from the system and updating permissions accordingly.
